title: Party Stash
description: True move semantics for the shared party stash: dragging an item between a dnd5e Group actor and one of its members moves it instead of copying it, when you own both sides. The system's own drop pipeline does the work — the source is only deleted after the copy lands, consumable stacks merge, container contents come along — and Ctrl-drag still forces a plain copy. All other drags (PC to PC, NPC looting, compendium drops) keep stock behavior.
